Geography & data notes Scope, assumptions, and sources

West Europe and North Europe belong to Azure's Europe geography. Sweden Central, Denmark East, and Italy North belong to the Sweden, Denmark, and Italy geographies. This view spans geographies within Europe.

Azure geography and ExpressRoute geopolitical coverage are different. These lines do not establish circuit availability or ExpressRoute Local eligibility. Region and peering markers are approximate metro references, not facility addresses; Dublin's overlapping markers are visually offset.

RTT = round(3 + 0.018 × great-circle distance in km). Zero distance means a shared reference coordinate, not zero network latency. Validate your shortlist with directional measurements from the customer's network.
